cpu.semantics: Sample weights; user/kernel intersections overlap. Frame coverage does not prove source caller attribution; generic thread roots and missing/truncated unwinds remain explicit.

offcpu.semantics: Per-thread intervals; gate wrapper and training model main are distinct. Worker seconds overlap and must not be added to model-main wall time.

published_model_wait_groups.selection: Actual model-main TID, blocked_sleep only; observed user frames containing accumulate_features or PendingPreparedPageBatch::finish; runnable time excluded. Finish context includes one allocator-futex group.
published_model_wait_groups.scope: Same-TID disjoint intervals; worker waits are not added.

fio.definition: fio issued/read requests per second, not physical block completions or NVMe commands

thermal.limitation: Saved snapshots do not observe the temperature peak between snapshots and do not establish absence of thermal performance effects.

limits: New post-reboot data epoch only; never pool missing historical raw runs or old golden hashes.
All seven principal configurations retain five none/queue pairs; observer overhead is measured without a numeric pass cutoff or correction factor.
CPU and offCPU are separate full-work runs; timings cannot be aligned exactly or added as if concurrent.
CPU sample weights and getpid-bearing stacks are observations, not syscall counts or predicted speedup; unresolved callers remain explicit.
OffCPU worker intervals overlap; summing worker seconds does not yield main-thread wall time.
Native completed Read/Readv SQEs are application requests after coalescing; mmap bypasses this counter.
Physical rates count final block-device completions in kernel phase windows; pure target is a lower attribution bound and possible target an upper bound.
Block-visible dispatched depth and fio application outstanding requests are different quantities; neither proves NVMe internal queue occupancy.
fio whole-device counters include foreign traffic and setup/ramp time; fio rates use their separate measured window.
Per-trial SMART before/after snapshots retain all numeric counter/time deltas; between-snapshot temperature peaks are unobserved.
Measured read-only filesystem/device-path envelope is demonstrated; absolute SSD maximum and percent of vendor maximum are unproven. No authoritative exact-SKU family mapping.

V1 known-read qualification failed its target-DATA ownership oracle and remains failed; V2 qualifies target reads/writes, PID-empty flush, and global balanced DATA chains without journal-write causality.
Training model-main PID comes from actual native fit metadata; wrapper gate PID is labeled separately and never substituted for model-main waits.
Accepted principal70-v2 only; failed principal70-v1 is retained separately. Final post-payload drain increased10→60s; measured phase clocks exclude it.
Resident means filesystem page residency, not a prewarmed Direct userspace cache. Direct physical reads in this configuration do not demonstrate a defect or a warm-native-cache CPU ceiling.

separate_core_local_qualification.scope: Postdates frozen performance archive; this native binary was not used for the reported performance runs.

measurement_scope.statement: Performance measurements remain scoped to frozen published candidate; acaa is a separately built/rebased correctness qualification.

separate_core_ci.scope: Closed exact-head correctness/platform CI; separate native binary, not a performance measurement or binary-equivalence claim.

isolated_replay.scope: Accepted observer raw replay plus all none-row file identities; failed attempts are retained and hash-verified separately, never promoted to successful measurements
isolated_replay.none_rows: File identity only; no raw observer exists
